recognize_zh: 視野中有多個中性球（neutrophil）被一圈紅血球緊密環繞、呈花瓣狀排列（neutrophil-erythrocyte rosette），背景可見少數小而緻密、缺乏中央淡染區的紅血球，提示自體免疫溶血性貧血（AIHA）。
features: Several segmented neutrophils each encircled by a single ring of closely apposed red cells, forming flower-like rosettes
Red cells in the rosettes are radially arranged and slightly deformed where they abut the neutrophil membrane
Neutrophils show normal lobation and granulation without visible ingested red cells (no erythrophagocytosis in this field)
Occasional small dense red cells lacking central pallor (spherocyte-like) and a rare polychromatic cell in the background
Scattered normal-sized platelets; no red cell agglutination clumps or schistocytes evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows multiple neutrophils each surrounded by a ring of adherent erythrocytes, forming neutrophil-erythrocyte rosettes. The rosetting neutrophils are morphologically unremarkable, and no definite erythrophagocytosis is seen in this field. The background red cells include occasional small dense spherocyte-like forms and a rare polychromatic cell; no large agglutinates or schistocytes are identified. Findings are suggestive of antibody-mediated red cell coating, as seen in autoimmune hemolytic anemia; correlation with DAT and hemolysis markers is recommended.

ddx.vs: Agglutination forms irregular free-floating red cell clumps without a central leukocyte, whereas rosettes are an organized ring of red cells around a neutrophil.
Erythrophagocytosis shows red cells or pale vacuoles inside the neutrophil cytoplasm, while rosetting red cells remain external and adherent to the cell surface.
Satellitism is an EDTA artifact of platelets, not red cells, ringing neutrophils.
Rouleaux are linear stacked red cells like coins without a central leukocyte, typically with a bluish proteinaceous background.
